instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to Settings > Checkout.
Click on 'Customize checkout' and select the 'Additional information' section from the left-hand menu.
Scroll down to the 'Return reasons' section and click on the 'Add return reason' button.
Enter a name for your new return reason in the 'Name' field, then add any additional details or instructions as needed in the 'Description' field.
Once you've created your return reason, navigate back to the Shopify theme editor by clicking on 'Online Store > Themes > Actions > Edit code'.

roi_summary: Nobody's Child can expect to see significant commercial improvements across various aspects of their business within the 12-week roadmap timeframe. The Returns Reason Capture (uc_001) will be implemented in week 1, resulting in a reduction in returns rates. Automated Review Collection (uc_004) and Abandoned Cart Recovery Emails (uc_002) will also be implemented in week 1, generating more reviews and recovering attributed revenue. In weeks 2-3, Email Marketing Automation Flows (uc_006) will be set up, delivering high returns on investment. The Size Guide Chatbot (uc_005) will be implemented in weeks 4-6, reducing size-related returns. Finally, AI Demand Forecasting (uc_008) and Dynamic Pricing Engine (uc_010) will be deployed in weeks 9-12, improving forecasting accuracy and gross margin.
